candidate.answerReason: The vehicles close 250 km at 100 km/h, taking 2.5 hours. This is before their meeting time of 3 hours.

methods.label: Combined-distance equation
methods.explanation: Before they meet, the two vehicles have traveled a combined distance of \(300-50=250\) km. Let the time be \(t\) hours. Then \((60+40)t=250\). Solving gives \(t=2.5\).
methods.levelReason: Uses the distance relationship and a simple one-variable equation, within grade 7.
